Meet the 2026 Ford F-150 King Ranch SuperCrew a premium hybrid pickup engineered for those who demand both capability and refinement. This striking black beauty combines the legendary toughness of the F-150 platform with innovative hybrid efficiency, delivering 23 mpg combined without sacrificing the power and torque today's truck owners expect. With just over 7,000 miles, this King Ranch represents an exceptional opportunity to own a next-generation truck that balances luxury appointments with genuine off-road prowess.

The 3.5L PowerBoost Full-Hybrid V6 with 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD provides commanding performance and superior fuel economy. Java leather King Ranch Multicontour seats offer premium comfort, while the twin panel moonroof, B&O Unleashed Sound System, and SYNC 4 navigation create a refined cabin experience. The FX4 Off-Road Package, Pro Power Onboard 7.2kW charging, heated steering wheel, and adaptive suspension technology ensure this truck is ready for work or weekend adventure. Additional refinements include the tough bed spray-in bedliner, power-deployable running boards, and auto-dimming rear-view mirror.

This vehicle is certified by Hudson with coverage under 5 years or 75,000 miles, giving you confidence and peace of mind.

Visit us to experience the commanding presence and capability this King Ranch delivers. Our team is ready to answer your questions and arrange a test drive at your convenience.

This 2025 Ford F-150 Tremor 4WD is powered by the 3.5L EcoBoost V6 paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission. Finished in Space White Metallic, this is the loaded Tremor configuration with the 402A High Package, Tremor leather seats, Twin Panel Moonroof, Torsen front differential, Tow/Haul Package, and B&O Unleashed audio.

The 3.5L EcoBoost is a great match for the Tremor.

With 400 horsepower and 500 lb-ft of torque, it delivers a huge amount of torque low in the RPM range. That makes the truck feel strong both on and off the pavement, while also giving you plenty of power when there's a trailer behind it.

But what makes a Tremor different from a regular F-150 with an appearance package is the hardware underneath it.

This one has the Torsen front differential along with Ford's two-speed 4WD system with mechanical locking capability. The Torsen helps distribute torque across the front axle when traction gets difficult, giving the truck another advantage when you're climbing, dealing with mud, or navigating uneven terrain.

You also get the Tremor's more aggressive off-road setup and the distinctive modular front bumper. It's a truck that's actually designed to leave the pavement rather than simply look like it can.

Then there's the 402A High Package, and that's what makes this Tremor such a good all-around truck.

Inside, you get the upgraded Tremor leather-trimmed bucket seats, heated second-row seats, heated steering wheel, Head-Up Display, B&O Unleashed premium sound system, wireless charging, Connected Navigation, and ambient lighting.

The huge Twin Panel Moonroof opens up the entire cabin and is one of those options that makes a noticeable difference in an F-150 SuperCrew.

This truck also gets the Mobile Office Package, including a console worksurface and partitioned lockable rear storage. Whether you're working out of the truck, traveling, or just need somewhere secure to keep gear, it's genuinely useful.

It's properly equipped to tow too. The Tow/Haul Package and integrated trailer brake controller give you important factory equipment for pulling a camper, boat, or equipment trailer. You still get all the off-road capability of the Tremor without sacrificing the everyday usefulness you'd expect from an F-150.

The Bed Utility Package adds LED box lighting and additional tie-down points, while the power tailgate makes accessing the bed easier.

And Space White Metallic is a great color on a Tremor. It's a little more distinctive than a traditional bright white and works especially well against the Tremor's dark exterior details and rugged bumper treatment.

Mileage is another plus. This F-150 is sitting 576 miles below the market average.

That's what makes this truck such a strong combination. You're getting the real off-road hardware of a Tremor, but also the equipment of a high-end everyday truck: 402A High, 3.5 EcoBoost, Torsen front differential, leather, Twin Panel Moonroof, Head-Up Display, B&O Unleashed, Tow/Haul Package, and Mobile Office Package.

If you're searching for a 2025 Ford F-150 Tremor 3.5 EcoBoost 4x4 near Lancaster, this Space White truck has the loaded configuration and capability that make the 402A Tremor one of the most desirable F-150 setups.

See it today at Mark Martin Motors in Ephrata, serving Lancaster, Lititz, Lebanon, and York. Call or message us to check availability or schedule your test drive.

2018 Jeep Grand Cherokee Trackhawk For Sale in "Ivory White Pearl!"

707HP Supercharged HEMI | 1-Owner | Completely Stock | Clean Carfax | 46K Miles

WE FINANCE


Finding a Trackhawk isn't particularly difficult. Finding one that hasn't been messed with is another story entirely.

Finished in beautiful Ivory White Pearl over Black leather, this 2018 Jeep Grand Cherokee Trackhawk has traveled just 46,000 miles with a Clean Carfax, one-owner history and perhaps most importantly remains completely stock.

No pulley. No tune. No aftermarket exhaust. No collection of questionable modifications to figure out.

Just the ridiculous machine Jeep built in the first place.

707 horsepower. Supercharged 6.2L HEMI V8. All-wheel drive. And room for five.

Turns out that's still plenty.


Completely Stock. That's the Point.

The Trackhawk was already excessive straight from the factory.

Its supercharged 6.2L HEMI V8 produces 707 horsepower and 645 lb-ft of torque, sending power through an 8-speed automatic transmission and full-time four-wheel-drive system.

Jeep quoted 0-60 mph in 3.5 seconds and a top speed of 180 mph.

In a Grand Cherokee.

Eight years later, those numbers still sound ridiculous.

But what makes this particular Trackhawk increasingly interesting isn't what somebody added to it.

It's what they didn't.

This one remains completely stock, exactly the way Jeep engineered it.


The Right Interior.

The Ivory White Pearl exterior is paired with the optional Signature Laguna Leather-Wrapped Interior Package, giving the cabin a considerable step up from the standard Trackhawk treatment.

Laguna leather seating is joined by leather-wrapped lower interior panels and a suede-like premium headliner, while the dual-pane panoramic sunroof opens up an otherwise dark, performance-focused cabin.

Then there's the audio system.

19 Harman Kardon speakers and a subwoofer.

Because apparently a 707-horsepower family SUV needed a soundtrack other than the supercharger.

Factory Options & Equipment Include:


Signature Laguna Leather-Wrapped Interior Package
Leather-Wrapped Lower Interior Panels
Suede-Like Premium Headliner
Dual-Pane Panoramic Sunroof
High Performance Audio
19-Speaker Harman Kardon Premium Audio with Subwoofer
Trailer Tow Group IV
20" x 10" Black Satin Aluminum Wheels
Supercharged 6.2L HEMI V8
8-Speed Automatic Transmission
Full-Time Four-Wheel Drive
Brembo High-Performance Brakes
Adaptive Suspension
Heated & Ventilated Front Seats
Heated Rear Seats
Heated Steering Wheel
Navigation
Apple CarPlay & Android Auto
Adaptive Cruise Control
Blind Spot Monitoring
Remote Start
Power Liftgate



707 Horsepower Wasn't the Crazy Part.

Plenty of manufacturers have put big horsepower into SUVs since the Trackhawk arrived.

But there's something particularly entertaining about the way Jeep did it.

They took the familiar Grand Cherokee, stuffed the supercharged 6.2L HEMI from the Hellcat family under the hood, engineered an all-wheel-drive system capable of dealing with it, added enormous Brembo brakes and essentially left the rest of the formula alone.

It's still comfortable. Still practical. Still has a usable cargo area.

It just happens to have 707 horsepower.

And when you're looking at one today, we'd argue the car underneath the horsepower matters more than ever.

One owner. Clean Carfax. 46K miles. Completely stock.

That's a Trackhawk we'd want.

description: Wholesale to the Public: AS-IS Used Cars at Deep Discounts ''Wholesale to the Public'' means you re buying a vehicle as-is, at a steeply discounted price, before we spend time and money reconditioning it for retail. These are typically older trade-ins or higher-mileage units. No warranty. No promises. Big savings. If you re handy, budget-savvy, or shopping for a basic commuter, this lane can be a win. What You re Getting (and Not Getting) You get: Rock-bottom pricing often below typical retail book values. Full transparency about what we know right now (intake notes, basic observations). Access to pre-purchase inspections bring your mechanic or arrange a mobile inspection. Clean title disclosure (as available) and standard sale paperwork. You don t get: No warranty, expressed or implied (as permitted by Tennessee law). No reconditioning (no fresh tires/brakes/fluids unless noted). No cosmetic fixes (expect dings, scratches, stained seats, etc.). No promises about future repairs you re taking on that risk. Translation: You re trading certainty for price. Who This Program Is For (...and not for) A good fit if you: Want the lowest possible purchase price and accept repair risk. Are comfortable with DIY fixes or have a trusted shop. Need a work truck, second car, teen s first car, or basic runabout. Are okay with cosmetic wear and potential mechanical needs. Not a good fit if you: Want turn-key reliability and retail-level reconditioning. Prefer warranty coverage or certified pre-owned standards. Don t have budget set aside for repairs after purchase. Typical Inventory You ll See Higher-mileage trade-ins that still run and drive. Vehicles with cosmetic issues (hail, faded paint, worn interiors). Units needing maintenance (tires, brakes, sensors, leaks). Niche/older models that aren t worth retail recon. Inventory changes daily first-come, first-served. How to Buy Browse our Wholesale List and pick a few VINs to inspect. Review our intake notes and arrange your pre-purchase inspection (optional, recommended). Decide and buy cash or certified funds preferred. Some lenders may finance older, high-mileage, as-is vehicles; approvals vary. Trades welcome. Taxes, tags, and fees apply. Radical Transparency (Read This Before You Visit) AS-IS = You own it, with all faults, at delivery. We encourage inspections. We do a basic intake evaluation so the car can be moved safely on-lot, but we don t diagnose everything. Expect unknowns. Price reflects condition and risk. If we reconditioned it, the price would be higher this program skips that step on purpose. FAQ Is ''Wholesale to the Public'' the same as an auction? No. You get auction-style pricing without needing a dealer s license. You inspect and buy directly from us. Can I get it inspected? Yes. Bring your mechanic or schedule a mobile inspection to our lot before you buy. Can I add a warranty later? Most third-party warranties require a qualifying inspection and vehicle criteria. For older/high-mileage units, coverage may be limited or unavailable. Ask, but plan as if there s no warranty. Why are these so cheap? Because we bypass reconditioning and price in the known and unknown repairs you may need to handle. Do you negotiate? Pricing is already discounted to move quickly. If you want ultra-low price, this is it; if you want fully reconditioned, shop our retail used inventory. Do you offer financing? Sometimes. Some banks won t finance older/high-mileage AS-IS units. If financing is a must, talk to us early.

description: Wholesale to the Public: AS-IS Used Cars at Deep Discounts ''Wholesale to the Public'' means you re buying a vehicle as-is, at a steeply discounted price, before we spend time and money reconditioning it for retail. These are typically older trade-ins or higher-mileage units. No warranty. No promises. Big savings. If you re handy, budget-savvy, or shopping for a basic commuter, this lane can be a win. What You re Getting (and Not Getting) You get: Rock-bottom pricing often below typical retail book values. Full transparency about what we know right now (intake notes, basic observations). Access to pre-purchase inspections bring your mechanic or arrange a mobile inspection. Clean title disclosure (as available) and standard sale paperwork. You don t get: No warranty, expressed or implied (as permitted by Tennessee law). No reconditioning (no fresh tires/brakes/fluids unless noted). No cosmetic fixes (expect dings, scratches, stained seats, etc.). No promises about future repairs you re taking on that risk. Translation: You re trading certainty for price. Who This Program Is For (...and not for) A good fit if you: Want the lowest possible purchase price and accept repair risk. Are comfortable with DIY fixes or have a trusted shop. Need a work truck, second car, teen s first car, or basic runabout. Are okay with cosmetic wear and potential mechanical needs. Not a good fit if you: Want turn-key reliability and retail-level reconditioning. Prefer warranty coverage or certified pre-owned standards. Don t have budget set aside for repairs after purchase. Typical Inventory You ll See Higher-mileage trade-ins that still run and drive. Vehicles with cosmetic issues (hail, faded paint, worn interiors). Units needing maintenance (tires, brakes, sensors, leaks). Niche/older models that aren t worth retail recon. Inventory changes daily first-come, first-served. How to Buy Browse our Wholesale List and pick a few VINs to inspect. Review our intake notes and arrange your pre-purchase inspection (optional, recommended). Decide and buy cash or certified funds preferred. Some lenders may finance older, high-mileage, as-is vehicles; approvals vary. Trades welcome. Taxes, tags, and fees apply. Radical Transparency (Read This Before You Visit) AS-IS = You own it, with all faults, at delivery. We encourage inspections. We do a basic intake evaluation so the car can be moved safely on-lot, but we don t diagnose everything. Expect unknowns. Price reflects condition and risk. If we reconditioned it, the price would be higher this program skips that step on purpose. FAQ Is ''Wholesale to the Public'' the same as an auction? No. You get auction-style pricing without needing a dealer s license. You inspect and buy directly from us. Can I get it inspected? Yes. Bring your mechanic or schedule a mobile inspection to our lot before you buy. Can I add a warranty later? Most third-party warranties require a qualifying inspection and vehicle criteria. For older/high-mileage units, coverage may be limited or unavailable. Ask, but plan as if there s no warranty. Why are these so cheap? Because we bypass reconditioning and price in the known and unknown repairs you may need to handle. Do you negotiate? Pricing is already discounted to move quickly. If you want ultra-low price, this is it; if you want fully reconditioned, shop our retail used inventory. Do you offer financing? Sometimes. Some banks won t finance older/high-mileage AS-IS units. If financing is a must, talk to us early.

GR Auto Gallery is pleased to present this one-of-a-kind, 1998 Jeep Wrangler for your consideration. This one-of-a-kind Wrangler features a custom Rustique exterior, a finish only available in the U.K., over a Gray interior. Powering this Jeep is a Magnuson-supercharged 5.7L V8 producing an impressive 580 horsepower, paired with a 4L65E 4-speed automatic transmission. The engine originally came out of a 1999 Corvette and has been fully gone through and rebuilt. This Wrangler has undergone a nut-and-bolt frame-off restoration within the last 10 years, with an estimated 7,000 miles on the build. Underneath, this Jeep is equipped with Ford 8.8 rear end with Ford 8.8 gears, a front Dana 44 TracRok Pro Edition, a 6-inch long-arm suspension, Fox shocks, and an insane suspension setup that makes this an ultimate rock climber. Additional features and upgrades include a fully caged chassis, custom Star Wars-themed touches, an NRG Innovations quick-disconnect steering wheel, PRP racing seats, Speedhut gauges, Holley EFI fuel injection, a SmittyBilt winch, ARB onboard air compressor, custom spare tire holder, and much more. This meticulously constructed Wrangler is an incredible combination of custom styling, serious off-road capability, and V8 performance. Drive this one out of our showroom or have us assist with shipping it to you anywhere in the United States! Don't hesitate to call us with any questions or for more information.



The 1998 Jeep Wrangler was part of the TJ generation, which debuted for the 1997 model year as a major evolution of the iconic Wrangler platform. The TJ retained the classic Jeep styling and removable top and doors while introducing a coil-spring suspension system in place of the previous leaf-spring setup, significantly improving both ride quality and off-road articulation. The Wrangler's compact dimensions, traditional four-wheel-drive layout, and rugged construction made it a favorite among off-road enthusiasts. The TJ generation also developed an enormous aftermarket following, allowing owners to customize these Jeeps for everything from trail driving and rock crawling to highly modified show vehicles. The 1998 model year continued Jeep's tradition of offering a highly capable and easily customizable platform that remains popular with enthusiasts today.
